name: Law firm
description: Sober, credible site for solicitors, accountants or consultants. Practice areas, fees and an enquiry page.

content.heading: Law without the jargon
content.subheading: We explain your options in words you can act on, and tell you what each one costs.

content.heading: How we work
content.body: You get one named solicitor, not a case number passed between desks. We agree a fee before starting, and we write to you in plain English.

content.heading: Client feedback
content.quote1: Told me honestly that I did not have a case. Saved me thousands.
content.quote2: Completed our purchase three weeks faster than the previous firm managed.
content.quote3: Difficult circumstances handled with real tact.

content.heading: Not sure where you stand?
content.subheading: The first twenty-minute conversation is free and carries no obligation.

content.heading: Fees
content.subheading: What we charge, written down before we begin.

content.heading: Fixed-fee services
content.plan3Note: per hour, billed in six-minute units

content.heading: About fees
content.q1: Are the fixed fees really fixed?
content.a1: Yes. If the matter turns out to be more complex we tell you before doing the work, and you decide.
content.a2: Costs we pay on your behalf, such as search fees and stamp duty. We list them separately at cost.
content.a3: For some dispute work, yes. We will say at the first meeting whether your matter qualifies.
content.a4: Fixed-fee work is payable on completion. Hourly work is billed monthly.

content.heading: Contact
content.subheading: Call, write, or come to the office.
